versions.subject: Merge PR #4827 from @netgrain - New analytic for python pth files
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFilename|re: '(?i)/lib/python3\.([5-9]|[0-9]{2})/site-packages/' #Unix and macOS
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.pth'
condition: selection
